Super Speaky!
история Speak & Smile · читаем хором
тапни / стрелка →
One rainy day…
Speaky reads a super-hero comic.
His eyes go — WOW!
🦝 I want to be a hero!
I can JUMP!
Cape on — now he's Super Speaky!
Over the puddle — jump, jump, jump!
💪 Watch me!
I can RUN!
Zoom past the swings —
run, run, run!
💨 So fast!
I can CLIMB!
Up the big tree —
one, two, three!
🧗 Nearly there!
I can SWIM!
Into the pond —
splish, splash, swim!
🏊 Splash!
“I can FLY!”
Speaky jumps… SPLASH! — into the mud!
But Coco grabs a balloon — up, up, up!
🐶 Woof! 🎈
Up floats Coco!
Hooray for Coco and the big red balloon!
And what can YOU do?
🦸 Jump! Run! Hooray!
